IS/IEC 60255 : Part 1 : 2009 : Measuring Relays and Protection Equipment Part 1 Common RequirementsICS 29.120.70ETD 35Reaffirmed 2020NATIONAL FOREWORDThis Indian Standard (Part 1) which is identical with IEC 60255-1 : 2009 'Measuring relays and Protection Equipment Part 1 Common requirements' issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the Power Systems Relays Sectional Committee, and approval of the Electrotechnical Division Council.This standard is a part of series of standards based on IEC 60255 series which shall replace IS 3231 series on adoption. Other parts of the series are:Part 5 Insulation coordination for measuring relays and protection equipment - Requirements and testsPart 8 Thermal electrical relaysPart 11 Voltage dips, short interruptions, variations and ripple on auxiliary power supply portPart 12 Directional relays and power relays with two input energizing quantitiesPart 13 Biased (percentage) differential relaysPart 16 Impedance measuring relaysPart 21 Vibration, shock, bump and seismic tests on measuring relays and protection equipmentSection 1 Vibration tests (sinusoidal)Section 2 Shock and bump testsSection 3 Seismic testsPart 22 Electrical disturbance testsSection 1 1 MHz burst immunity testsSection 2 Electrostatic discharge testsSection 3 Radiated electromagnetic field immunitySection 4 Electrical fast transient/burst immunity testSection 5 Surge immunity testSection 6 Immunity to conducted disturbances induced by radio frequency fieldsSection 7 Power frequency immunity testsPart 24 Common format for transient data exchange (COMTRADE) for power systemsPart 25 Electromagnetic emission tests for measuring relays and protection equipmentPart 26 Electromagnetic compatibility requirementsPart 27 Product safety requirementsPart 127 Functional requirements for over/under voltage protectionPart 151 Functional requirements for over/under current protection
